templates.name: Initial Visit
templates.ros_template:
CONSTITUTIONAL: Denies fever, chills, night sweats, cold intolerance, fatigue, decreased oral intake, or unintentional weight change.
EYES: Denies visual changes, loss of vision, blurred vision, diplopia, eye pain, or purulent discharge.
EARS: Denies hearing loss, difficulty hearing, ear pain, or ear drainage.
NOSE: Denies nasal congestion, rhinorrhea, nasal discharge, epistaxis, sneezing, or snoring.
MOUTH/THROAT/VOICE: Denies sore throat, dysphagia, dental problems, or voice changes.
NECK: Denies neck pain, stiffness, lumps, swelling, or nuchal rigidity.
CARDIOVASCULAR: Denies chest pain, palpitations, dyspnea at rest, dyspnea with activity, orthopnea, or lower-extremity edema.
RESPIRATORY: Denies dyspnea/SOB, cough (productive or nonproductive), sputum, hemoptysis, or wheezing.
GASTROINTESTINAL: Denies abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting (including hematemesis), constipation, diarrhea, or changes in bowel habits.
GENITOURINARY: Denies dysuria, hematuria, urinary hesitancy, polyuria, urinary incontinence, or flank pain.
MUSCULOSKELETAL: Denies muscle pain, muscle weakness, decreased muscle strength, joint pain, joint swelling, or stiffness.
SKIN/DERMATOLOGIC: Denies rash, pruritus, skin sores, bruising, lesions, or perineal/groin rash.
NEUROLOGICAL: Denies headaches, lightheadedness, numbness, tingling, weakness, tremors, or syncope.
PSYCHIATRIC: Denies depression, anxiety, suicidal ideation, hallucinations, delusions, or paranoia.
ENDOCRINE: Denies heat intolerance, cold intolerance, polyuria, polydipsia, or fatigue.
HEMATOLOGIC/LYMPHATIC: Denies easy bruising, bleeding (including epistaxis), lymph node enlargement, or lymph node tenderness.
OTHER: None reported.
templates.pe_template:
GENERAL: NAD. Well-developed, pleasant, appears comfortable. A&O x3. Follows commands. Appropriate speech.
HEENT: NCAT. Conjunctiva clear without injection; conjunctivae and lids normal. PERRLA. EOMI/EOM intact B/L. Hearing intact B/L. MMM. External ears and nose normal without lesions. Nasal mucosa normal.
NECK: Supple. Trachea midline. No JVD. No cervical LAD.
RESPIRATORY: Breathing comfortably on room air; no use of accessory muscles. Speaks in full sentences without difficulty. CTAB. Equal breath sounds B/L. No wheezes, rhonchi, or rales.
CARDIOVASCULAR: RRR. Normal S1/S2. No murmur, rub, or gallop. Peripheral pulses intact. No edema.
ABDOMEN: Soft, non-distended, NT. +BS x4. No rebound or guarding. No HSM.
LYMPHATIC: No cervical, clavicular, or posterior auricular LAD.
MUSCULOSKELETAL: Full ROM of upper extremities. Strength 5/5 BUE and BLE. No joint enlargement or tenderness. No clubbing, cyanosis, or petechiae. No deformities observed.
SKIN: Intact. No rashes, lesions, or erythema on exam of face, hands, or exposed areas.
NEUROLOGIC: CN II-XII grossly intact. Reflexes 2+ and symmetrical. Sensation intact to touch and position in BLEs. No focal deficits.
PSYCHIATRIC: Good eye contact. Normal mood and affect.

templates.name: Subsequent Visit
templates.ros_template:
CONSTITUTIONAL: Denies fever, chills, loss of appetite, fatigue, or weakness.
CARDIAC: Denies chest pain, shortness of breath with exertion, or swelling in the legs.
RESPIRATORY: Denies cough, nocturnal dyspnea, or shortness of breath.
DIGESTIVE: Denies nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, constipation, or diarrhea.
MUSCULOSKELETAL: Denies muscle aches or cramps, body aches, or arthritis.
SKIN: Denies lumps/bumps, rash, or skin tear.
OTHER: None reported.
templates.pe_template:
CONSTITUTIONAL: Alert, no acute distress. Well developed and nourished.
SKIN: Warm and dry, no suspicious lesions.
PULMONARY: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.
CARDIOVASCULAR: Regular rate and rhythm, S1, S2 normal, no murmurs.
EXTREMITIES: No clubbing, cyanosis, or edema.
PSYCH: Good eye contact. Normal mood and affect.

templates.name: Neurology
templates.ros_template:
CONSTITUTIONAL: Denies fever or chills.
EYES: Denies visual change or diplopia.
ENT: Denies nuchal rigidity or rhinorrhea.
CARDIOVASCULAR: Denies chest pain.
RESPIRATORY: Denies wheezing or shortness of breath.
GI: Denies diarrhea, abdominal pain, or constipation.
GU: Denies urinary incontinence or dysuria.
NEURO: As per HPI.
PSYCH: Denies depression or anxiety.
MSK: Denies joint pain or swelling.
SKIN: Denies rash or pruritus.
ENDOCRINE: Denies heat intolerance or fatigue.
HEMATOLOGIC: Denies bruising or epistaxis.
templates.pe_template:
MENTAL STATUS/PSYCH: Alert and oriented to ***; attention intact to WORLD forwards and backwards; fluent speech; normal language comprehension; memory intact to the details of the history.
CRANIAL NERVES: VFFTC, PERRL, EOMI, facial strength and sensation intact and symmetric, tongue and palate midline, traps full. No dysarthria.
MOTOR EXAM: Normal bulk and tone, no pronator drift, finger and foot taps fast. Strength (R/L) - Delt 5/5 Biceps 5/5 Triceps 5/5 WE 5/5 WF 5/5 FE 5/5 FF 5/5 IO 5/5 IP 5/5 Hams 5/5 Quads 5/5 TA 5/5 Gastroc 5/5 EHL 5/5
REFLEXES: 2+ throughout and symmetric, toes down-going bilaterally.
SENSORY: Intact to LT, vibration, pin prick throughout. Romberg negative.
COORDINATION: Intact FNF, HKS
GAIT: Normal narrow based. Able to walk on heels, toes, and tandem.

templates.name: Psychiatry
templates.ros_template:
DEPRESSIVE SYMPTOMS: Denies depressed mood, low motivation, fatigue, poor concentration, or social withdrawal.
ANXIETY SYMPTOMS: Denies panic attacks, racing thoughts, irritability, difficulty concentrating, hypervigilance, or excessive worry.
SLEEP: Denies insomnia (difficulty falling asleep), insomnia (difficulty staying asleep), fragmented sleep, nightmares, daytime sleepiness, or poor sleep quality.
APPETITE: Denies decreased appetite, increased appetite, emotional eating, weight loss, weight gain, or food aversion.
SI/HI: Denies suicidal ideation with plan, suicidal ideation without plan, homicidal ideation with plan, or homicidal ideation without plan.
HALLUCINATIONS: Denies auditory hallucinations or visual hallucinations.
DELUSIONS/PARANOIA: Denies delusional thinking or paranoid thinking.
MANIC SYMPTOMS: Denies mood swings, increased energy, less need for sleep, reckless behaviors, pressured speech, or more talkative.
templates.mse_template:
Appearance: Well-groomed, dressed appropriately
Behavior/Rapport: No apparent disturbance, calm and cooperative, conversational
Movement: No psychomotor agitation observed
Speech: Normal rate, rhythm, and tone
Mood: Affect congruent to mood
Orientation: Alert and oriented
Attention/Concentration: Sustained
Thought Process: Linear
Thought Content: No SI, no HI, no delusions, obsessions, preoccupations, paranoia, or phobias
Insight: Intact
Judgment: Intact
